name: L99 Story Engine
mission: Provide a provenance-safe AI runtime and story operations layer with tenant isolation, revocation, recovery, observable promotion gates, and controlled publishing boundaries.

capabilities.notes: Repository contains executable Python and Node components, but no single canonical full-repository build artifact is established.
Promotion-gate and security tests exist; exact-head passing evidence must be attached before verification.
Exact-head promotion gates are defined, but this contract does not claim a passing run.
No deployment artifact is attached to this contract.
Rollback concepts and events exist, but an executed rollback proof is not attached.
Operational events and dashboards exist, but production runtime health is not proven.
Production readiness is blocked by hardened session design and complete workspace authorization proof.
Partitioning and isolation contracts exist; live persistence behavior is not fully verified here.
Runtime services and handlers exist; a complete externally supported API contract is not yet proven.
AI runtime and provider operating contracts exist; live model behavior is outside this file's proof boundary.
No MCP execution proof is attached.
Promotion gates and event producers automate checks, but end-to-end production automation is not proven.
L99 latency and operational telemetry analyzers exist; production completeness is not proven.
Event bus, correlation IDs, dashboards, and latency monitors exist without current runtime proof.
Known blockers include Stripe signature verification, browser-readable key persistence, CSP hardening, and authorization coverage.
Artifact writers and event contracts exist; immutable exact-head evidence binding is the next gate.

verification.purpose: Verify the existing Founder Control Room federation contract.
Run provenance, revocation, partition, event, drift, shell, and latency gates.
Verify header authentication and cookie rejection behavior.

rollback.method: Revert the exact promoted commit and replay revocation and operational events through the append-only event spine.

blockers: Cryptographic Stripe webhook verification is not proven.
Browser-readable API-key persistence requires hardened authentication and session design.
Browser Content Security Policy requires tightening.
Workspace authorization must be proven on every read and mutation path.
Exact-head CI evidence has not yet been attached to this contract.
next_gate: Run exact-head capability and promotion validation, bind immutable workflow evidence to the commit, and only then promote supported capability states.
